text:
If I had to start today, what would I do and is it worth to do it now? Need opinions
NO AI

Been with mutual funds since mid of 2023. But like a noob in early days, i tinkered a lot with funds and wasted crucial time. It was in mid of 2024 when i had finalised by funds. 

Consistently invested via sip, added lump sums and stepped up sip amount. Started with 4 digits now playing with 6 digit monthly sip. Matured and learned a lot as an investor, and now looking back I often ask this question:

With everything I have learned so far, would I still choose the same? answer is honestly not as straightforward.

Background: mid twenties, long term horizon (10+ years) and aggressive investing appetite. Drawdowns are seen as opportunities and I am bullish on India in very long term. 

All the funds below were added as time progressed, so please take this point into consideration.

Current MF portfolio: I drive a pair of funds in broader category. Reason is investment and management style, 2 funds with different style brings some dynamics, one could be aggressive other absorbs the same. Overall risk is high but still investing style risk is mitigated.

1) Active Small cap: Quant and Nippon - Quant seen as aggressive, Nippon is old timer, long term proven consistency.

2) Active Mid Cap: Motilal and Edelweiss - motilal drives a heavily concentrated with a different level of risk/reward and edelweiss balances out with sort of linear approach.

3) Flexi cap: Sbi Contra and JM - Contra give
ai_reason: Started with 4 digits, now 6-digit SIP; funds added over time; says they matured and learned a lot.
